question: Where is the nearest golf course located toward northwest from School of Cosmetology, Somerset, KY?
sql: WITH school_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' ) SELECT gc.name FROM golf_courses gc, school_location sl WHERE sl.geometry IS NOT NULL AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, gc.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 -- Northwest direction ORDER BY gc.geometry <-> sl.geometry LIMIT 1;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
